title: go-oauth-auditor agent input
description: Note: working_directory is NOT a valid field for this agent. OAuth locations are provided from go-index.json, not by path.

oauth_locations.description: OAuth/OIDC relevant locations in the codebase, extracted from the cartographer's go-index.json oauth_locations field. This is the primary input — do NOT pass working_directory instead.

target_profile.description: OAuth spec profile to audit against. oauth_2_1 = OAuth 2.1 draft; oauth_2_0 = RFC 6749/6750; oauth_2_0_with_9700_bcp = OAuth 2.0 + RFC 9700 Best Current Practice.

features_in_use.description: OAuth features detected in the codebase (e.g. pkce, refresh_tokens, device_flow, ciba). Used to scope which checklist items apply.

review_session_id.description: UUID identifying the current security review session.

code_ref.description: Git reference of the code being reviewed.

code_ref_dirty.description: True if the working tree has uncommitted changes at review time.
